messages:
Maya (AE): MeridianHealth asked for a focused perf POC that matches their private VPC + customer KMS. They want p95 < 320ms at seq=512 for interactive flows. Can we run a short validation next Mon? cc @Noah
Noah (Solutions Eng): Plan: provision dedicated pool eu-west-2, model=redwood-v2-large, enable mTLS + HSM. Test cases: (1) streaming+warmed+fp16; (2) streaming+warmed+int8; (3) non-streaming+warmed+int8; (4) cold-cache baseline. Warmup 8k, steady 10m at 180 QPS. Capture p50/p95/p99, token breakdown, and HSM histograms.
Ivy (ML Eng): Use Meridian anonymized prompts (we have the bucket). For int8 run both static quant and kernel-optimized paths. Include a cold-cache run with KV cache off.
Carlos (SRE): I'll provision pool and pin nodes. Need Meridian CIDRs and KMS cert. Deploy snippet:
```
helm upgrade --install meridian-test ./charts/dedicated \\  --set model.name=redwood-v2-large \\  --set tls.enabled=true \\  --set kms.provider=hsm \\  --set autoscale.min=2 --set autoscale.max=6
```
deploy-bot: deploy started: redwood/dedicated/meridian-test @2101112235
Reed (CISO - MeridianHealth): We can provide CIDRs and certs. Compliance may require per-request HSM unwrap; procurement wants cost delta.
Noah (Solutions Eng): We'll run both modes: per-request HSM and cached-envelope. Expect ~6ms per-request cost vs ~1.5ms cached. We'll produce side-by-side latency+cost numbers.
Carlos (SRE): Quick smoke (cached-envelope + int8 streaming, seq=512, 180QPS): p50=70ms, p95=205ms, p99=410ms, error_rate=0.1%. Observed occasional host GC correlated with p99 spikes. Will collect GC traces + HSM latency histograms.
Ivy (ML Eng): Median looks good. For p99 we should try boosting pool to 8 nodes, enable aggressive prefix-warm, and rerun int8+fp16 comparison.
Maya (AE): I'll communicate this to Reed and flag pricing: if per-request HSM required, include ~\u00a00.12-0.14/request uplift. Reed  can you confirm compliance constraint by EOD Fri?
Reed (CISO - MeridianHealth): Will confirm with procurement by EOD. If cached-envelope is acceptable, we prefer that. Thanks team.
